name: At random
summary: This EA opens random buy or sell positions at regular intervals without any technical analysis or strategy logic. It is essentially a randomized trading experiment that relies on pure chance rather than market signals to determine trade direction and timing.
summary_zh: 这个EA在固定时间间隔内随机开仓买入或卖出，不使用任何技术分析或策略逻辑。它本质上是一个随机交易实验，完全依赖运气而非市场信号来决定交易方向和时机。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念完全基于随机性，没有任何技术指标或市场分析作为决策依据。入场条件是按照设定的时间间隔，通过随机数生成器决定开多仓或空仓，没有任何趋势判断或信号确认。出场条件依赖于固定的止损和止盈设置，但核心逻辑不具备任何方向性优势。仓位管理使用固定手数，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险控制机制，没有最大持仓限制、回撤保护或资金分配策略。整体而言，这是一个概念验证型EA，展示了MQL5的随机交易能力，但缺乏可盈利的交易逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is entirely based on randomness, with no technical indicators or market analysis used for decision-making. Entry conditions are determined by a random number generator at set time intervals, deciding whether to open a buy or sell position without any trend judgment or signal confirmation. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings, but the core logic lacks any directional edge. Position sizing uses fixed lots without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management lacks risk control mechanisms, with no maximum position limits, drawdown protection, or capital allocation strategy. Overall, this is a proof-of-concept EA demonstrating MQL5's random trading capability but lacks any profitable trading logic.
pros: 代码简洁易懂，适合MQL5初学者学习EA基本结构
展示了随机数生成器在交易中的应用方法
具有止损止盈设置，提供基本的风险控制
pros_en: Simple and easy-to-understand code, suitable for MQL5 beginners learning basic EA structure
Demonstrates the application of random number generators in trading
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings providing basic risk control
cons: 完全随机交易没有任何统计优势，长期必然亏损
缺乏市场状态判断，在任何行情条件下都会开仓
没有仓位管理和资金管理机制，容易在连续亏损中爆仓
缺少点差过滤和交易时段限制，在不利条件下也会交易
cons_en: Completely random trading has no statistical edge and will inevitably lose money long-term
Lacks market condition assessment, opens positions regardless of market state
No position sizing or money management mechanism, vulnerable to account blow-up during losing streaks
Missing spread filter and trading session restrictions, trades even under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件，避免在不利行情中开仓
实现基于账户权益的动态仓位管理，控制最大回撤
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters to avoid opening positions in unfavorable market conditions
Implement equity-based dynamic position sizing to control maximum drawdown

risk_points: 无市场分析随机开仓，胜率接近50%但扣除点差后必亏
没有持仓数量限制，可能同时持有多个同方向仓位放大风险
缺乏回撤保护和最大亏损限制机制
risk_points_en: Random entry without market analysis, win rate near 50% but guaranteed loss after spread costs
No position count limit, may hold multiple same-direction positions amplifying risk
Lacks drawdown protection and maximum loss limit mechanisms
